hv9jfbgm9.name: Arvin
hv9jfbgm9.visualAnchor: Lean, exacting older aerospace architect with a narrow angular silhouette, deeply tanned olive skin, short steel-gray hair, heavy-lidded dark amber eyes, and disciplined field presentation. Olive utility jacket with blue solar-cell shoulder straps, restrained analog instrumentation, practical canvas work trousers and field boots. His synthetic graft is ONLY his RIGHT HAND; the left hand is natural. Grease, dust and damage stay localized to work actually performed in the current scene.
